about: S&S Power Switchgear Ltd is the listed holding company of an electrical-engineering group supplying high-voltage disconnectors and retrofit services through SSPSE, protection and control panels through Acrastyle UK, LV panels through APIL and automation systems for aluminium smelters through HART. The group serves utilities and industrial customers across India, the UK and export markets. [1] [2]
